messages:
Maya (People Ops): @here Heads-up: All-hands this Wednesday 11:00 AM PT — hybrid. Main topics: data retention policy change, Private deployment checklist, and a short incident RCA. Please add Qs to the doc: https://forms.gle/redwood-ah-questions
Rina Patel (Security): Will present the new Data Retention Policy (changes to 90 -> 30 day logs for hosted API) and compliance implications. Will share policy doc Tue.
Tom Alvarez (Product): Quick demo of Private onboarding flow (5 mins). We'll show the new KMS integration and checklist.
Jules (Engineering): I'll summarize last week's incident (model spec mismatch) and the mitigation we rolled out. Short timeline + follow-ups.
Andre Vogel (CEO): Ill open with company highlights and customer momentum; also a brief on our go-to-market adjustments for Dedicated.
Clara (Sales): Noting some customers asked for longer log retention for audits. Can we surface configurable retention options in the Q&A?
Maya (People Ops): Format: 40 min total. 10 min exec, 10 min security/policy, 8 min product demo, 7 min incident recap, 5 min ops/next steps, 10 min Q&A. Recording + transcript posted after.
allhands-bot: :bell: Reminder scheduled  All-hands Wed 11:00 AM PT. Calendar link updated.
Rina Patel (Security): Policy doc: https://confluence.redwood/security/data-retention-2026. TL;DR: default hosted retention reduced to 30 days for logs; Private customers can opt for extended retention under contract.
Tom Alvarez (Product): Demo deck uploaded: https://redwood.share/drive/private-onboard-demo. Ping me if you want a tech deep-dive follow-up.
Jules (Engineering): Incident notes: root cause was a schema mismatch between model artifacts and runtime descriptors; added schema validation in pipeline and improved alerting.
Clara (Sales): I'll compile customer asks about retention and pass them to Rina before the call.
Maya (People Ops): Please post 1-2 top questions here or in the form by Tue 5 PM so we can prioritize live Qs.
Maya (People Ops): (after meeting) Recording: https://redwood.co/recordings/4100000000-allhands. Key takeaways below.
Maya (People Ops): TAKEAWAYS: 1) Hosted default log retention shortened to 30 days; opt-in extended retention via contract. 2) Private onboarding now supports out-of-box KMS rotations. 3) Incident fixes: schema validation and better alerts. 4) Action: Security to publish FAQ; Sales to collect customer retention needs.
Andre Vogel (CEO): Thanks team  tight and practical meeting. Expect a follow-up email with owners and deadlines.
Rina Patel (Security): Follow-up: FAQ draft will be shared by Fri EOD.
Jules (Engineering): Posting incident playbook updates in the incident tracker.
Maya (People Ops): Actions & owners added to the follow-up doc; I'll paste the list into #all-hands after this.
Maya (People Ops): Closing: if you missed the call, please review the recording and add any follow-ups to the doc. :white_check_mark:
